title: Research prototype interpretation guidance

allowed_claims.confidence: Confidence is the highest probability reported by the model and is not a calibrated clinical probability.
allowed_claims.uncertainty: Uncertainty is represented here by one minus the highest model probability; it is not a validated clinical uncertainty estimate.
allowed_claims.salient_regions: A saliency or Grad-CAM artifact indicates image regions that influenced the model output; it is not a lesion boundary or segmentation mask.
allowed_claims.location: A location is reported only when supplied in verified metadata or by a verified segmentation artifact.

limitations: This system summarizes model artifacts and does not diagnose disease.
The classifier was developed as a research prototype and is not a medical device.
Model errors, dataset shift, annotation quality, and calibration limitations can affect the output.
A human-qualified reviewer must assess the original image and all relevant clinical information.
